277543294.description:
Kingdom
Professional Premium 92 Minute Blank Audio Cassette Tapes
Bulk Lot
This is a bulk lot of vintage blank audio cassette tapes from Kingdom Tapes & Electronics. These "Professional Premium" tapes provide a 92-minute recording capacity (46 minutes per side) and feature a clean white shell design. Produced in the United States, these cassettes were designed for high-fidelity voice and music reproduction, making them a preferred choice for professional and ministry distribution during the peak of the analog era.
High-quality white cassette shells with no pre-applied labels
92-minute total recording time (C-92) across two sides
Made in the USA at the Kingdom facility in Mansfield, PA
Measurements (Original Box): 17" x 11" x 3"
Original decorative storage box with vintage American flag graphic
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with tapes appearing unused. The cassette shells are clean and free of dust or physical damage. The outer cardboard shipping box shows moderate shelf wear, including some compression at the corners and light surface scuffing consistent with long-term storage.

277602161.description: This listing includes a lot of five fossilized seashells, likely from marine bivalves and gastropods. The shells are fully mineralized with earthy and stony textures in natural brown, tan, and gray tones. Sizes range from approximately 1.5 to 3 inches each, shown next to a ruler for scale. The total weight of the lot is 269.2 grams. All items are in used, natural condition with visible wear, embedded sediment, and some broken or incomplete sections typical for fossils. This Fossil Bivalves Grab Bag is suitable for fossil collectors, educational use, or natural decor.

277567955.description: Polished lepidolite sphere approximately baseball size (about 2inches in diameter). Lepidolite is a lilac-gray to rose-colored mica mineral, popular among collectors and for metaphysical use. The sphere has a smooth, glossy finish with natural patterning visible beneath the surface. There are no visible chips or cracks. The handwritten label on the surface is slightly wrinkled and partially peeling. This specimen is in good, gently used condition, suitable for mineral collections or decorative display.
